description:
On the credits page a bunch of space agencies show up under Wikimedia Commons instead of where they belong.

## Reporter answers (follow-up)

Q: Routing target for CMSA (121 entries): should images from agency='CMSA' be grouped under CNSA (the existing 'cnsa' source-logo), or should a new CMSA source-logo entry be added?
A: Group under the existing 'cnsa' section.

Q: Routing target for USAF (20 entries): should images from agency='USAF' be grouped under the existing 'us-space-force' source-logo, or should a new USAF entry be added?
A: Group under the existing 'us-space-force' section.

Q: Routing target for SpaceIL (9 entries): should a new source-logo entry be created for SpaceIL, or should it route to an existing bucket?
A: Create a new source-logo entry for SpaceIL with section id 'spaceil'.

Q: (Optional) Routing target for CFHT (1 entry) and EHT (1 entry) — same question.
A: I don't know.
